name: Auto Click Timing
description: Learns by trial and error which click timings get you past the spots where you die, then delays your early clicks so they land on the learned time.

max-shift-ms.name: Max delay (ms)
max-shift-ms.description: The most the mod will ever delay a click. This is also the size of the buffer window around each learned click time.

search-step-ms.name: Search step (ms)
search-step-ms.description: How much later to try the click on each new attempt. Smaller is more precise but takes more attempts. 4 ms is one step at 240 TPS.

debug.name: Show status messages
debug.description: Shows on-screen messages when the mod tries a delay or learns a fix, and logs to the Geode log.
